paper_metadata.title: A high-density non-equiatomic WTaMoNbV high-entropy alloy: Alloying behavior, microstructure and mechanical properties

evidence.quote: A bulk fine-grained W35Ta35Mo10Nb10V10 (at%) high-density high-entropy alloy (HEA) was successfully fabricated by mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS) with varying parameters.

The ball milling was carried out in stainless-steel vials filled with tungsten carbide balls at a ball-to-powder ratio of 10:1 using a planetary ball mill at 300 rpm.
The bulk W35Ta35Mo10Nb10V10 HEA samples were then fabricated in an SPS furnace (FCT, HPD25/3; FCT Systeme GmbH) using the powders ball milled for 55 h.
